title: Python Forge Version 1 Curriculum Architecture
description: Scalable modular curriculum hierarchy designed for mobile-first interactive Python learning.

modules.title: Python Foundations
modules.description: Master the absolute basics of executing code, handling standard input/output, and defining basic state with variables.

missions.title: Hello World
missions.description: Every programmer starts here. Forge your very first instruction to print text to the console.
missions.objective: Print exactly "Hello, World!" to the console.
hints: Text strings in Python must be enclosed in quotation marks.

missions.title: Variables
missions.description: Variables act as containers to store data values. Let's assign a value and display it.
missions.objective: Create a variable named message, assign "Python Forge" to it, then print it.
hints: Use the = operator to assign a value to a variable.
Make sure to pass the variable name directly to the print() function without using quotation marks.
